name: ui-source
description: One component's shadcn registry item, with its source files when the site exposes them. Never cached.

verbs.name: registry
verbs.description: Fetch one registry item URL, as ui-catalog lists it. Prints the item's file paths, one per line, or the item with --json.

url.description: Registry item URL, such as https://kobra.systems/r/input-otp.json.

verbs.name: parse
verbs.description: Registry item from a file already on disk.

path.description: A shadcn registry item JSON file.
